paper: Designing Agentic AI-Based Screening for Portfolio Investment, uploaded August 10 2026 version, sections 4.2 and 5.2.2
scope: Adapt portfolio objectives to the two frozen bandit strategy indices. Same seven long-only capital targets, next-close weekly execution, source trading costs and incremental resizing charges as retained Q. Not a replication of stock screening or high-dimensional estimation. Ledoit-Wolf linear shrinkage is a robustness control, not the paper's nonlinear shrinkage estimator.
selection: All configurations reported. Within each objective family, choose the covariance estimator by 2018-2021 Sharpe, with alphabetical case-name ties; carry the same choice to 2022-August 2025. No later-period selection.
target_return_fallback: If no allowed target attains the paper's 1% monthly forecast return, choose the highest forecast mean and explicitly record infeasibility. This is a labeled fallback, not a solution to an infeasible constrained problem.
